**Template name**
One word describing the design style (e.g. `linear`, `stripe`, `supabase`).

**Description**
Brief description of the design philosophy and best use case.

**Colors**
- Primary: `#HEX` — purpose
- Secondary: `#HEX` — purpose
- Background: `#HEX`
- Surface: `#HEX`
- Text: `#HEX`
- Text Secondary: `#HEX`

**Typography**
- Heading: Font Name (weight, size)
- Body: Font Name (weight, size)
- Mono: Font Name (for code)

**Layout**
- Max width
- Spacing scale
- Responsive behavior

**DESIGN.md content**
Paste the full DESIGN.md template content here:

```markdown
# Template Name Design System
...
```
